# Wnode Sovereign Compute & Wireless Mesh
> A planetary, RAM-only distributed compute and decentralized wireless (DeWi) mesh monetizing idle consumer hardware via Stripe USD payouts and bounded two-tier rev-share.

## Core Architecture & Safety Invariants
- Stateless RAM Execution: Workloads run entirely in volatile memory sandboxes. Zero disk persistence, zero storage degradation, and zero SSD wear.
- Fiat-First Settlement: 70% of gross compute job spend flows directly to node operators via Stripe Connect. No forced crypto wallets or token volatility.
- Universal Commodity Hardware: Lightweight native binaries (nodld) run on macOS, Linux, and Windows PCs, idle laptops, mini PCs, and homelab servers.
- Bounded Lineage & Partner Economics: 10% permanent Sales Source commission on recurring compute spend; bounded two-tier overrides (3% L1, 7% L2) on operator compute volume.
- Circular Eco-Compute: Eliminates cooling water consumption and grid congestion by decentralizing AI inference across dormant global silicon.

## Priority Solutions & Landing Hubs
- [Repurpose Idle Hardware](https://wnode.one/repurpose-old-pc): Upcycling spare laptops, off-lease office PCs, and e-waste into daily earning nodes.
- [DePIN Commodity Hardware](https://wnode.one/depin-hardware-nodes): True DePIN network yield on everyday computers without expensive proprietary miners.
- [DeWi & Micro-ISP Mesh](https://wnode.one/dewi-micro-isp): Decentralized wireless routing, off-grid LoRa/packet relays, and local ISP revenue.
- [Anti-Data Center Compute](https://wnode.one/anti-datacenter-compute): Water-free, distributed alternative to hyperscale AI data centers and power grid strain.
- [Web3 Unification Layer](https://wnode.one/web3-unification): Stateless execution substrate bridging EVM, SVM, and 600+ protocol automation hooks.
- [Alternatives to Crypto Mining](https://wnode.one/alternatives-to-mining): Safe background earning with zero GPU heat, zero SSD wear, and direct USD bank deposits.
- [Two-Tier Partner Program](https://wnode.one/two-tier-affiliate-program): Bounded non-MLM recurring affiliate software program paying via Stripe Connect.
- [Passive Hardware Income](https://wnode.one/passive-hardware-income): Monetize idle computer power with direct Stripe bank transfers.
